stories.headline: AI coding startup Cognition raises $1B+ at $26B valuation, run-rate revenue hits $492M

key_facts.fact: Cognition, maker of the autonomous AI software engineer Devin, raised more than $1 billion at a $25 billion pre-money valuation, announced May 27, 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Cognition, the makers of the autonomous AI software engineer named Devin, has raised more than $1 billion at a $25 billion pre-money valuation, the company announced on Wednesday.

key_facts.fact: The new valuation is roughly $26 billion post-money, up sharply from a $10.2 billion post-money valuation when it closed a $400 million round eight months earlier in September.
key_facts.excerpt: That's a major leap from its $10.2 billion post-money valuation when it closed a $400 million funding round just eight months ago in September.

key_facts.fact: Cognition says its run-rate revenue has grown to $492 million, up from $37 million in May 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: AI coding startup Cognition raised more than $1B at a $26B valuation, and says its revenue run rate has increased to $492M from $37M in May 2025.

key_facts.fact: The round was led by Lux Capital and General Catalyst, with existing investors including Founders Fund and 8VC and new investors Ribbit Capital, Atreides, and Layer Global.
key_facts.excerpt: The round was led by Lux Capital and General Catalyst, with existing investors pouring in, including Founders Fund, 8VC, and others. The round also included new investors Ribbit Capital, Atreides, and Layer Global.

stories.headline: Salesforce's Agentforce ARR passes $1.2B, up 205%, as agentic revenue tops $1B for first time

key_facts.fact: Salesforce reported Agentforce annual recurring revenue of $1.2 billion, up 205% year-over-year, in Q1 FY2027 results announced May 27, 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Agentforce and Data 360 annual recurring revenue ('ARR') reaches nearly $3.4 billion, up over 200% Y/Y, including $1.1 billion Informatica Cloud ARR and $1.2 billion Agentforce ARR, up 205% Y/Y

key_facts.fact: Agentforce annualized revenue crossed the $1 billion mark for the first time, with combined AI and data ARR reaching about $3.4 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Annualized revenue from Agentforce reached $1.2 billion, up 205% year over year. The figure came in above $1 billion for the first time.

key_facts.fact: Salesforce processed 28.6 trillion tokens in the quarter, up 152% quarter-over-quarter, and delivered 3.8 billion agentic work units for customers.
key_facts.excerpt: The company processed 28.6 trillion tokens in Q1, up 152% quarter-over-quarter, generating 3.8 billion agentic units

key_facts.fact: The company signed a record 98 deals worth over $1 million in new ACV in Q1, including a new $72 million enterprise license agreement with the US Air Force, and raised full-year revenue guidance to $45.9-$46.2 billion.

stories.headline: Mistral signs AI deals with Airbus and BMW, pressing Europe's case for tech sovereignty

key_facts.fact: French AI firm Mistral announced partnerships with carmaker BMW and aerospace company Airbus on May 28, 2026, aiming to grow by linking with defence and industry giants.
key_facts.excerpt: French AI firm Mistral on Thursday announced partnerships with carmaker BMW and aerospace company Airbus as it aims to boost its growth by fostering links with defence and industry giants.

key_facts.fact: Mistral signed a five-year partnership with Airbus to apply AI to defence, space and helicopter manufacturing, including flight safety in the cockpit and aircraft design via digital simulation; the contract value was not disclosed.
key_facts.excerpt: His group signed a five-year partnership with Airbus to apply AI to defence and space activities and helicopter manufacturing -- though the value of the contract has not been revealed.

key_facts.fact: Under the Airbus agreement, Airbus will buy licences for Mistral AI's full product suite for on-premises and trusted-cloud deployment across commercial aircraft, helicopter, defence and space activities, with strict security and sovereignty requirements.
key_facts.excerpt: Under the agreement, Airbus will acquire licences for the full Mistral AI product suite, enabling the deployment of models on-premises, in trusted clouds or wherever it makes sense for Airbus and its customers.

key_facts.fact: For BMW, Mistral will build models that 'understand the physics' of vehicles to optimise crash-test procedures; Mistral also announced a 10-megawatt compute deal with Digital Realty, against four-billion-euro European data-centre plans.
key_facts.excerpt: For BMW, Mistral would build specific models that 'understand the physics' of the vehicles and are intended to optimise crash-test procedures. The company also announced Thursday a deal for 10 megawatts of computing power with American data centre operator Digital Realty.

key_facts.fact: Mistral framed the push as accelerating AI superintelligence development to secure Europe's independence from US tech giants.
key_facts.excerpt: Mistral says it is accelerating superintelligence development to ensure Europe's independence from US tech giants, and signs deals to supply Airbus and BMW.

stories.headline: Illinois passes SB 315, first US law to require independent third-party audits of frontier AI

key_facts.fact: The Illinois House gave unanimous 110-0 approval on May 27, 2026 to SB 315, the Artificial Intelligence Safety Measures Act, sending it to Gov. J.B. Pritzker's desk after Senate passage on May 21.
key_facts.excerpt: Legislators in the Illinois House of Representatives gave unanimous 110-0 approval this afternoon to SB 315, the Artificial Intelligence Safety Measures Act. The Senate approved the bill on May 21, so the measure now goes to the desk of Gov. J.B. Pritzker.

key_facts.fact: If signed, Illinois would be the third state to set frontier-model standards, following New York's RAISE Act and California's SB 53, and the first to require annual independent third-party audits of safety protocols.
key_facts.excerpt: Illinois would become the third state to set frontier model standards, following New York's RAISE Act and California's SB 53, the Transparency in Frontier AI Act... It also requires annual independent third-party audits of safety issues—the first such requirement in any state AI law.

key_facts.fact: The Act requires large frontier developers to publish and annually update a framework covering catastrophic-risk assessment, mitigations, cybersecurity, internal governance, and risks from internal use, and to report critical safety incidents.
key_facts.excerpt: It would require large frontier developers to create, implement, publish, and annually update a frontier AI framework addressing catastrophic-risk assessment, mitigations, cybersecurity, internal governance, third-party evaluations, and risks from internal use of frontier models.

key_facts.fact: SB 315 goes beyond existing AI legislation from California and New York regulating America's largest AI companies.
key_facts.excerpt: The measure, SB 315, goes beyond legislation from California and New York regulating America's largest AI companies.

stories.headline: OpenAI Foundation commits initial $250M to help workers and economies navigate AI disruption

key_facts.fact: The non-profit that controls OpenAI said on May 27, 2026 it will commit an initial $250 million for grants, partnerships and direct work to help workers and economies navigate AI-driven disruption — its first such commitment.
key_facts.excerpt: The non-profit that controls OpenAI will commit an initial $250 million for grants, partnerships and direct work aimed at helping workers and economies navigate the disruption caused by AI technology, it said on Wednesday.

key_facts.fact: The funds will back labor-market research, support workers and communities facing near-term displacement, and explore ways to distribute AI's economic gains more broadly; first initiatives are due later in the year.
key_facts.excerpt: The funds, the first such commitment from the OpenAI Foundation, will back research into AI's impact on the labor market, support workers and communities facing near-term displacement and explore new ways to distribute economic gains from AI more broadly.

key_facts.fact: Longer-term, the foundation wants to turn policy ideas into testable designs, including shifting taxation from labor toward capital, windfall mechanisms, and sovereign wealth funds modeled on Norway's pension fund and Alaska's Permanent Fund.
key_facts.excerpt: For longer-term economic security, the foundation said it wants to move promising policy ideas into testable designs, including shifting taxation from labor toward capital, windfall mechanisms, and public or sovereign wealth funds. It cited Norway's Government Pension Fund and Alaska's Permanent Fund as relevant models.

key_facts.fact: The OpenAI Foundation received a 26% stake in OpenAI's for-profit entity last year, valued at $130 billion at the time, and in March committed to investing at least $1 billion through the non-profit over the next year.
key_facts.excerpt: The OpenAI Foundation received a 26% stake in the startup's for-profit entity last year as part of a restructuring that valued its holding at $130 billion at the time... In March, OpenAI committed to investing at least $1 billion through the non-profit over the next year.

stories.headline: Orbital Industries raises $50M Series B for AI-designed materials and data-center cooling

key_facts.fact: Orbital Industries, a startup using AI to design advanced materials, raised a $50 million Series B led by Plural, announced May 28, 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Orbital Industries, a startup using AI to design advanced materials, has raised a $50 million Series B funding round led by the venture capital firm Plural.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia's venture arm NVentures, a prior investor, joined the round along with returning investors Radical Ventures, Compound and Fly Ventures.
key_facts.excerpt: Nventures, the venture arm of AI chip company Nvidia, which had previously invested in Orbital, joined the round along with other prior investors Radical Ventures, Compound and Fly Ventures.

key_facts.fact: The London- and San Francisco-based company (formerly Orbital Materials) used its AI platform to develop a PFAS-free dielectric cooling fluid and a modular data-center system for next-generation GPUs, via a multi-year partnership with AWS.
key_facts.excerpt: Its first commercial product is a dielectric cooling fluid engineered specifically for next-generation GPUs... entirely free of PFAS forever chemicals... In parallel, it has developed a modular data centre system that can be manufactured off-site and deployed in as little as six months... Both products are being developed through a multi-year partnership with AWS.

key_facts.fact: Its underlying engine Orb, an AI model for simulating atoms' quantum-mechanical behavior, can simulate 100,000 atoms on a single GPU and runs 10x faster than models from Microsoft and Meta, per independent benchmarks cited by the company.
key_facts.excerpt: The company's Orb AI engine is designed to simulate the behaviour of atoms on a large scale, powering materials discovery. It's claimed it can simulate 100,000 atoms on a single GPU, running models 10 times faster than competitors from Microsoft and Meta.

key_facts.fact: Orbital Industries was founded in 2022 by Jonathan Godwin (who spent nearly a decade at DeepMind), James Gin-Pollock and Daniel Miodovnik, and employs 50 people; Plural partner Ian Hogarth led the investment.
key_facts.excerpt: Orbital Industries, the London-headquartered industrial technology company founded in 2022 by Jonathan Godwin, James Gin-Pollock, and Daniel Miodovnik... The company employs 50 people across London and San Francisco. Godwin spent nearly a decade at DeepMind.

stories.headline: Tensormesh raises $20M from Nvidia, AMD and CoreWeave to cut AI inference waste

key_facts.fact: Tensormesh raised $20 million, announced May 27, 2026, with participation from Nvidia, AMD and CoreWeave alongside Valley Capital Partners and Laude Ventures.
key_facts.excerpt: Today's round saw the participation of Nvidia Corp., Advanced Micro Devices Inc. and CoreWeave Inc., as well as the venture capital firms Valley Capital Partners and Laude Ventures.

key_facts.fact: The company's technology makes AI inference more efficient by eliminating redundant computations; the round brings its total raised to $24.5 million.
key_facts.excerpt: Tensormesh Inc. has hit upon a way to make artificial intelligence inference more efficient by eliminating the need for redundant computations... It brings Tensormesh's total amount raised so far to $24.5 million.

key_facts.fact: The funding coincides with the launch of its flagship software-as-a-service offering, Tensormesh Inference, and will expand hardware integrations with AMD, Nvidia and CoreWeave.
key_facts.excerpt: it coincides with the launch of its flagship software-as-a-service offering, Tensormesh Inference. The money from today's round will be used to expand Tensormesh's hardware integrations with AMD's, Nvidia's and CoreWeave's infrastructure and accelerate product development.

key_facts.fact: Tensormesh remains committed to the underlying open-source LMCache project.
key_facts.excerpt: The company also remains committed to the underlying, open-source LMCache project, which will be the main beneficiary of many of its planned upcoming innovations.
